in_marathi.name: Ekaant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ekaant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'eka' meaning 'one' and 'ant' meaning 'end', 'Ekaant' symbolizes being in a state of solitude or aloneness, often with a deeper spiritual meaning. In Hindu mythology, it is the name of a sage who attained enlightenment through deep meditation and seclusion.
